questions.statement: The note documents discussion of an individualized HbA1c goal around 8.0% or higher.

questions.question: Which patients with an iron treatment response decision note at WH-PRACTICE-1 in March 2030 have a note documenting that hemoglobin has risen since before iron treatment?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT n.record_id, n.patient_id FROM clinical_note n WHERE n.note_type = 'iron_treatment_response_decision' AND n.organization_id = 'WH-PRACTICE-1' AND n.event_date BETWEEN '2030-03-01' AND '2030-03-31'
questions.statement: The note documents that the patient's hemoglobin has risen compared with the pre-treatment value.

questions.question: How many inpatient discharge summaries (all own hospitals, all dates) report an echocardiographic LVEF below 50% from that admission?

questions.statement: The discharge summary reports an estimated LVEF below 50% from the admission echocardiogram.
questions.why_notes: The LVEF value is narrated in the summary.

questions.question: How many patients with a diagnostic result follow-up note at WH-PRACTICE-2 or WH-PRACTICE-7 (all dates) had a left ventricular ejection fraction below 40% reported?

questions.statement: The note reports a left ventricular ejection fraction below 40%.

questions.question: Which patients with a hospital illness discharge summary at WH-HOSPITAL-1 between August and December 2029 do not report having help available at home?

questions.statement: The discharge summary documents that the patient does not report help available at home.
questions.why_notes: Home support is interview content recorded in the medication/disposition section.

questions.question: How many gastroenterology consultation notes at WH-GI-1 between 1 and 15 June 2029 report the patient taking oral iron on fewer than 7 of the last 14 days?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT n.record_id, n.patient_id FROM clinical_note n WHERE n.note_type = 'gastroenterology_consultation' AND n.organization_id = 'WH-GI-1' AND n.event_date BETWEEN '2029-06-01' AND '2029-06-15'
questions.statement: The note reports that the patient took oral iron on fewer than 7 of the last 14 days.
questions.why_notes: Iron use is a patient report in the medication interview.

questions.question: Which patients seen at WH-OUTSIDE-AUDIOLOGY-2 or WH-OUTSIDE-AUDIOLOGY-3 had a hearing test result outside expected limits, such as threshold elevation?

questions.statement: The audiology note documents hearing thresholds outside expected clinical limits (for example threshold elevation or hearing loss).

questions.question: How many rehabilitation progress notes at WH-REHAB-0 (all dates) document that treatment was tolerated without increased pain?

questions.statement: The note documents that the therapy session was tolerated without increased pain.
questions.why_notes: Tolerance of treatment is narrative.

questions.question: How many patients with a medication start note written between 1 and 15 May 2027 (all practices) had a GLP-1 receptor agonist such as semaglutide started in that note?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT n.record_id, n.patient_id FROM clinical_note n WHERE n.note_type = 'medication_start' AND n.event_date BETWEEN '2027-05-01' AND '2027-05-15'
questions.statement: The note documents starting a GLP-1 receptor agonist such as semaglutide.
questions.why_notes: The intended start and class rationale are in the note; prescriptions may be unlinked.

questions.question: How many patients had a problem list update note at WH-PRACTICE-3 in 2027 that added essential hypertension to the problem list?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT n.record_id, n.patient_id FROM clinical_note n WHERE n.note_type = 'problem_list_update' AND n.organization_id = 'WH-PRACTICE-3' AND n.event_date BETWEEN '2027-01-01' AND '2027-12-31'
questions.statement: The note documents that essential hypertension was added as a new problem.
questions.why_notes: The basis for the added problem is narrative.

questions.question: How many observation progress notes at WH-HOSPITAL-3 written in 2027 or 2028 document that a support person can collect the patient and help at home?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT n.record_id, n.patient_id FROM clinical_note n WHERE n.note_type = 'observation_progress_note' AND n.organization_id = 'WH-HOSPITAL-3' AND n.event_date BETWEEN '2027-01-01' AND '2028-12-31'
questions.statement: The note documents that a support person will collect the patient or help at home.
questions.why_notes: Discharge support is narrated in the interval text.

questions.question: How many lipid treatment reassessment notes at WH-PRACTICE-3 in September and October 2027 document muscle symptoms (aching) while on a statin?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT n.record_id, n.patient_id FROM clinical_note n WHERE n.note_type = 'lipid_treatment_reassessment' AND n.organization_id = 'WH-PRACTICE-3' AND n.event_date BETWEEN '2027-09-01' AND '2027-10-31'
questions.statement: The note documents that the patient has muscle symptoms (such as aching) attributed to or occurring on a statin (a note saying no muscle symptoms were reported does not count).
questions.why_notes: Statin tolerability is reported in conversation.

questions.question: How many broader laboratory follow-up notes at WH-PRACTICE-4 in October 2028 report a ferritin below 30 ng/mL?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT n.record_id, n.patient_id FROM clinical_note n WHERE n.note_type = 'broader_laboratory_followup' AND n.organization_id = 'WH-PRACTICE-4' AND n.event_date BETWEEN '2028-10-01' AND '2028-10-31'
questions.statement: The note reports a ferritin value below 30 ng/mL.
questions.why_notes: The ferritin value the clinician reviewed is quoted in the note, possibly from an older specimen.

questions.question: How many patients with a youth health supervision note at WH-PRACTICE-0 between 1 and 14 January 2030 have a note reporting that at least one eye did not meet the vision screening threshold?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT n.record_id, n.patient_id FROM clinical_note n WHERE n.note_type = 'youth_health_supervision' AND n.organization_id = 'WH-PRACTICE-0' AND n.event_date BETWEEN '2030-01-01' AND '2030-01-14'
questions.statement: The note reports that at least one eye did not meet the vision screening threshold.
questions.why_notes: Vision screening interpretation is narrative.

questions.question: Which patients with a medication history review note at WH-PRACTICE-4 between 20 and 31 December 2028 have a note documenting that they do not recognize a listed medicine as current?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT n.record_id, n.patient_id FROM clinical_note n WHERE n.note_type = 'medication_history_review' AND n.organization_id = 'WH-PRACTICE-4' AND n.event_date BETWEEN '2028-12-20' AND '2028-12-31'
questions.statement: The note documents that the patient does not recognize at least one listed medicine as a current medicine.
questions.why_notes: Medication recognition is an interview statement.

questions.question: How many home health PT progress notes at WH-HOMECARE-0 written between 1 and 20 August 2029 document that assistance is still needed?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT n.record_id, n.patient_id FROM clinical_note n WHERE n.note_type = 'home_health_pt_progress' AND n.organization_id = 'WH-HOMECARE-0' AND n.event_date BETWEEN '2029-08-01' AND '2029-08-20'
questions.statement: The note documents that the patient still needs assistance with mobility.
questions.why_notes: Functional assistance is described in the assessment text.

questions.question: How many readable scanned radiology reports received in January 2027 describe an abnormal lung finding, either a possible pneumonia or infiltrate or a pulmonary nodule?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT d.record_id, d.patient_id FROM scanned_document d WHERE d.document_type = 'Radiology Report' AND d.readable = 1 AND d.event_date BETWEEN '2027-01-01' AND '2027-01-31'
questions.statement: The scanned report describes an abnormal lung finding: a possible or definite pneumonia or infiltrate, or a pulmonary nodule.
questions.why_notes: Scanned report findings exist only as page text (often with OCR errors).

questions.question: Which patients have a readable scanned radiology report received between 1 March and 15 April 2028 that reports a pulmonary nodule or thyroid nodule?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT d.record_id, d.patient_id FROM scanned_document d WHERE d.document_type = 'Radiology Report' AND d.readable = 1 AND d.event_date BETWEEN '2028-03-01' AND '2028-04-15'
questions.statement: The scanned report describes a pulmonary (lung) nodule or a thyroid nodule.
questions.why_notes: Incidental nodules needing follow-up are only in the report text.

questions.question: How many readable scanned radiology reports received in May 2029 report no acute abnormality (for example no acute findings, no acute cardiopulmonary or intra-abdominal process, or a normal study)?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT d.record_id, d.patient_id FROM scanned_document d WHERE d.document_type = 'Radiology Report' AND d.readable = 1 AND d.event_date BETWEEN '2029-05-01' AND '2029-05-31'
questions.statement: The scanned report's impression is normal or states there is no acute abnormality.
questions.why_notes: Normal versus abnormal can only be read from the impression text.

questions.question: How many patients have a readable scanned outside imaging document (document type Imaging - Outside) from January and February 2028 whose impression reports an abnormal finding rather than a normal study or no acute findings?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT d.record_id, d.patient_id FROM scanned_document d WHERE d.document_type = 'Imaging - Outside' AND d.readable = 1 AND d.event_date BETWEEN '2028-01-01' AND '2028-02-29'
questions.statement: The scanned imaging report's impression describes an abnormal finding (a normal study, a negative or benign mammogram, or 'no acute' findings does not count).
questions.why_notes: Normal versus abnormal can only be read from the scanned impression.

questions.question: How many patients have a readable scanned consult note received in March 2028 in which the specialist asks to see the patient again within 3 months or sooner?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT d.record_id, d.patient_id FROM scanned_document d WHERE d.document_type = 'Consult Note' AND d.readable = 1 AND d.event_date BETWEEN '2028-03-01' AND '2028-03-31'
questions.statement: The scanned consult letter asks for follow-up with the specialist in 3 months or sooner.
questions.why_notes: The follow-up interval is written only in the letter.

questions.question: How many readable scanned consult notes received in January 2029 give a specific clinical assessment rather than only stating that the patient was evaluated?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT d.record_id, d.patient_id FROM scanned_document d WHERE d.document_type = 'Consult Note' AND d.readable = 1 AND d.event_date BETWEEN '2029-01-01' AND '2029-01-31'
questions.statement: The scanned consult letter states a specific clinical assessment or diagnosis (a letter whose assessment only says the patient was evaluated, see plan, does not count).
questions.why_notes: Whether a letter is clinically informative can only be judged from its text.

questions.question: How many patients have a readable scanned specialist letter received in January through April 2029 recommending a medication change?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT d.record_id, d.patient_id FROM scanned_document d WHERE d.document_type = 'Specialist Letter' AND d.readable = 1 AND d.event_date BETWEEN '2029-01-01' AND '2029-04-30'
questions.statement: The scanned specialist letter recommends starting, stopping, increasing or otherwise changing a medication (a letter stating no medication changes does not count).
questions.why_notes: Recommendations exist only in the scanned letter text.

questions.question: How many readable scanned correspondence documents received January through June 2027 ask for specialist follow-up within 6 weeks?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT d.record_id, d.patient_id FROM scanned_document d WHERE d.document_type = 'Correspondence' AND d.readable = 1 AND d.event_date BETWEEN '2027-01-01' AND '2027-06-30'
questions.statement: The scanned letter asks for specialist follow-up in 6 weeks or sooner.
questions.why_notes: Follow-up intervals exist only in the letter text.

questions.statement: The scanned procedure report documents inadequate bowel preparation.

questions.statement: The scanned pathology report diagnoses at least one adenoma (for example a tubular or tubulovillous adenoma or sessile serrated lesion).

questions.scope_sql: SELECT d.record_id, d.patient_id FROM scanned_document d WHERE d.document_type = 'Outside Records' AND d.readable = 1 AND d.event_date BETWEEN '2027-01-01' AND '2027-03-31'
questions.statement: The scanned document recommends follow-up imaging, repeat testing or additional evaluation (such as nodule follow-up, additional imaging or a stress test).
questions.why_notes: Follow-up recommendations exist only in the scanned text.

questions.question: How many female patients have a readable scanned radiology report received in February 2027 describing a screening mammogram with a negative or benign result (BI-RADS 1 or 2)?

questions.statement: The scanned report is a screening mammogram with a negative or benign result (BI-RADS 1 or 2).

questions.question: How many readable scanned surgery/procedure documents received from 2028 through 2030 describe a procedure performed on the right side of the body?

questions.statement: The scanned document describes a procedure performed on the right side (right knee, right eye, right hand, etc.).
questions.why_notes: Laterality is only in the operative text.

questions.question: How many readable scanned miscellaneous documents received January through March 2029 have an impression reporting no acute abnormality or a normal study?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT d.record_id, d.patient_id FROM scanned_document d WHERE d.document_type = 'Miscellaneous' AND d.readable = 1 AND d.event_date BETWEEN '2029-01-01' AND '2029-03-31'
questions.statement: The scanned document is an imaging report whose impression is normal or reports no acute abnormality.

questions.question: How many patients have a readable scanned outside imaging document (document type Imaging - Outside) from January through March 2029 that states a prior study was available for comparison?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT d.record_id, d.patient_id FROM scanned_document d WHERE d.document_type = 'Imaging - Outside' AND d.readable = 1 AND d.event_date BETWEEN '2029-01-01' AND '2029-03-31'
questions.statement: The scanned imaging report states that a prior study was available for comparison (a report stating no comparison does not count).
questions.why_notes: Comparison availability is only in the report text.

questions.question: How many readable scanned specialist letters received in January through April 2028 ask to see the patient again in one year?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT d.record_id, d.patient_id FROM scanned_document d WHERE d.document_type = 'Specialist Letter' AND d.readable = 1 AND d.event_date BETWEEN '2028-01-01' AND '2028-04-30'
questions.statement: The scanned letter asks for specialist follow-up in 1 year.

questions.statement: The ED summary documents that the patient was admitted for further management (not treated and released).

questions.question: How many patients aged 17 or younger (latest reported age) have an HIE ED summary from January through March 2028 describing a fall with an extremity injury?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT h.record_id, h.patient_id FROM hie_document h WHERE h.document_type = 'ED summary' AND h.event_date BETWEEN '2028-01-01' AND '2028-03-31' AND h.patient_id IN (SELECT p.patient_id FROM patient p WHERE p.age_latest BETWEEN 0 AND 17)

questions.question: How many HIE ED summaries from January and February 2029 for patients aged 75 or older describe a respiratory presentation?

questions.statement: The ED summary describes a respiratory presentation (for example cough and fever, shortness of breath, wheezing, pneumonia, asthma or COPD).

questions.scope_sql: SELECT h.record_id, h.patient_id FROM hie_document h WHERE h.document_type = 'ED summary' AND h.event_date BETWEEN '2027-01-01' AND '2027-06-30' AND h.patient_id IN (SELECT c.patient_id FROM condition c WHERE c.normalized_label IN ('Essential hypertension','Essential (primary) hypertension'))
questions.statement: The ED summary describes presentation after a fall with an extremity injury.

questions.question: How many HIE discharge summaries authored by Florida outside hospitals (author organization WHN-HOSPITAL-FL-*) in 2028 ask for follow-up with a surgeon?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT h.record_id, h.patient_id FROM hie_document h WHERE h.document_type = 'Discharge summary' AND h.event_date BETWEEN '2028-01-01' AND '2028-12-31' AND h.author_organization_id LIKE 'WHN-HOSPITAL-FL-%'

questions.question: Which patients aged 75 or older have an HIE discharge summary from the first half of 2027 whose principal diagnosis is a cardiovascular condition?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT h.record_id, h.patient_id FROM hie_document h WHERE h.document_type = 'Discharge summary' AND h.event_date BETWEEN '2027-01-01' AND '2027-06-30' AND h.patient_id IN (SELECT p.patient_id FROM patient p WHERE p.age_latest BETWEEN 75 AND 120)
questions.statement: The discharge summary's principal diagnosis is a cardiovascular condition (for example heart failure, atrial fibrillation, myocardial infarction, coronary disease, aortic stenosis, stroke, syncope or chest pain with ACS ruled out).

questions.question: How many patients aged 50 or older have an HIE discharge summary from 1 March to 15 April 2029 describing an infection treated with antibiotics during the stay?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT h.record_id, h.patient_id FROM hie_document h WHERE h.document_type = 'Discharge summary' AND h.event_date BETWEEN '2029-03-01' AND '2029-04-15' AND h.patient_id IN (SELECT p.patient_id FROM patient p WHERE p.age_latest BETWEEN 50 AND 120)
questions.statement: The discharge summary documents an infection (such as pneumonia, urinary tract infection, sepsis, a COPD exacerbation treated with antibiotics, or cellulitis) treated with antibiotics during the stay.

questions.question: How many patients aged 50 or older have an HIE discharge summary from July and August 2028 documenting a surgical or interventional procedure during the stay?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT h.record_id, h.patient_id FROM hie_document h WHERE h.document_type = 'Discharge summary' AND h.event_date BETWEEN '2028-07-01' AND '2028-08-31' AND h.patient_id IN (SELECT p.patient_id FROM patient p WHERE p.age_latest BETWEEN 50 AND 120)

questions.statement: The ED summary describes a syncopal episode or a fall.
questions.why_notes: The reason for the outside ED visit is only in the HIE text.

questions.question: How many HIE ED summaries authored by Pennsylvania or Georgia outside hospitals (author organization WHN-HOSPITAL-PA-* or WHN-HOSPITAL-GA-*) from January through April 2029 document that imaging was performed?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT h.record_id, h.patient_id FROM hie_document h WHERE h.document_type = 'ED summary' AND h.event_date BETWEEN '2029-01-01' AND '2029-04-30' AND (h.author_organization_id LIKE 'WHN-HOSPITAL-PA-%' OR h.author_organization_id LIKE 'WHN-HOSPITAL-GA-%')
questions.statement: The ED summary documents that imaging (such as an X-ray, chest radiograph, CT or ultrasound) was performed.
questions.why_notes: Imaging done at outside EDs is only in the HIE narrative.

questions.question: How many HIE discharge summaries from January through April 2027 for female patients aged 18 to 45 document a delivery?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT h.record_id, h.patient_id FROM hie_document h WHERE h.document_type = 'Discharge summary' AND h.event_date BETWEEN '2027-01-01' AND '2027-04-30' AND h.patient_id IN (SELECT p.patient_id FROM patient p WHERE p.sex_reported = 'F' AND p.age_latest BETWEEN 18 AND 45)
questions.statement: The discharge summary documents a delivery (birth of an infant) during the stay.
questions.why_notes: Delivery is only in the outside discharge narrative.

questions.question: Which patients with a recorded hyperlipidemia diagnosis have an HIE ED summary from January through April 2028 that ended in hospital admission?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT h.record_id, h.patient_id FROM hie_document h WHERE h.document_type = 'ED summary' AND h.event_date BETWEEN '2028-01-01' AND '2028-04-30' AND h.patient_id IN (SELECT c.patient_id FROM condition c WHERE c.normalized_label IN ('Hyperlipidemia'))
questions.statement: The ED summary documents that the patient was admitted for further management.
questions.why_notes: Disposition is only in the HIE narrative.

questions.question: How many patients have an HIE ED summary authored by North Carolina outside hospitals (author organization WHN-HOSPITAL-NC-*) from January through June 2028 whose presenting problem was a pain complaint (abdominal, chest or back pain, or headache)?
questions.scope_sql: SELECT h.record_id, h.patient_id FROM hie_document h WHERE h.document_type = 'ED summary' AND h.event_date BETWEEN '2028-01-01' AND '2028-06-30' AND h.author_organization_id LIKE 'WHN-HOSPITAL-NC-%'
questions.statement: The ED summary describes a pain complaint (abdominal pain, chest pain, back pain or headache) as the presenting problem.
questions.why_notes: The presenting complaint exists only in the HIE narrative.
